logger.doc:name: Log Unhandled Application Error
logger.message:
#[output application/json --- { event: "UNHANDLED_APPLICATION_ERROR",
runId: vars.runId default "UNKNOWN_RUN",
triggerType: vars.triggerType default "UNKNOWN_TRIGGER",
sourceFilePath: vars.sourceFilePath default "UNKNOWN_SOURCE",
sourceFileName: vars.expectedSourceFileName default "UNKNOWN_FILE",
runStatus: vars.runStatus default "FAILED",
correlationId: correlationId,
errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default "MULE") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN"),
errorDescription: error.description default "Unhandled application error",
errorDetailedDescription: error.detailedDescription default error.description default "No detailed error description is available",
failingComponent: error.failingComponent default "UNKNOWN_COMPONENT",
occurredAt: (now() >> ("Asia/Kolkata" as TimeZone)) as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX" } }]
